prompt: Write the body (about 250 words) of a Texas personal injury petition by a car accident victim against an auto insurer, with the parts Parties, Facts, Negligence and Damages in plain text. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: neck strain. Use the exact placeholders [PLAINTIFF_NAME], [LOSS_DATE], [CITY] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1113; do not mention it.)
text:
Parties

Plaintiff [PLAINTIFF_NAME] is an individual residing in Texas who was the operator of a passenger vehicle involved in the collision described below. Defendant is an automobile liability insurer authorized to transact insurance business in the State of Texas, which issued a policy providing coverage to the at-fault driver and which is responsible for handling and resolving the related claims under that policy.

Facts

On [LOSS_DATE], Plaintiff was lawfully traveling in a single lane of traffic in [CITY]. Another vehicle, operated by the insured driver under Defendant's policy, attempted to change lanes into the lane Plaintiff occupied without first confirming that the lane was clear. The insured vehicle sideswiped Plaintiff's vehicle, striking the driver's side and forcing Plaintiff's vehicle to shift sharply. Plaintiff did not contribute to the collision and had no reasonable opportunity to avoid it. Plaintiff reported the collision and submitted a claim to Defendant for the resulting injuries and property damage.

Negligence

The insured driver owed Plaintiff a duty to exercise ordinary care when changing lanes, including keeping a proper lookout, signaling, and confirming that the movement could be made safely. The insured driver breached that duty by moving into an occupied lane without yielding, and that breach directly caused the collision. Defendant, as the insurer responsible for the policy, is liable for the damages its insured is legally obligated to pay, and Defendant has failed to fairly evaluate and promptly pay the claim as required under the Texas Insurance Code and the Texas Administrative Code.

Damages

As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered a neck strain, with pain, stiffness, limited range of motion, and headaches. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses for examination and treatment, lost time from work, and suffered physical pain and mental anguish. Plaintiff seeks actual damages in an amount to be determined by the trier of fact, and requests that Defendant be ordered to pay the sum of [DEMAND_AMOUNT], together with pre-judgment and post-judgment interest, costs of court, and such other relief to which Plaintiff may be entitled.
